title: After Deadly Floods Last Year Over 300 Texas Summer Camps Await Licenses To Open
report:

The delay is likely to cause disruptions for families who rely on these camps for childcare during the summer months.

3. Only nine summer camps have been approved to open so far.
4. The delay in licensure is likely to impact families who rely on these camps for childcare during the summer.
5. Summer camp season is set to start soon, adding urgency to the licensing process.
